support_desktop_pitch: Qafila is free, with no ads and no tracking. Support goes through a secure Stripe payment page (Apple Pay, Google Pay or card), opened in your browser.
downloads_footer: Files are saved to this folder without asking.
external_open_mail: Open this link in your email app?
external_open_tel: Open this number in your phone app?
page_crashed: This page stopped unexpectedly. Reload to try again.
scroll_desktop_footer: Fixed: the bar stays whole. Shrink: when you scroll down, only the domain remains; click it or scroll up to bring the bar back. Hide: the bar disappears when you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up or move the mouse to the edge. The page is never hidden under the bar.
fullscreen_notice: %1$s is now full screen · Press Esc to exit
fullscreen_notice_page: Full screen · Press Esc to exit
file_blocked: Files from this computer don't open in Qafila: a local page could read your other documents.
gallery_footer: Click a bar to use it; you can then fine-tune it in Customize.
bar_style_footer: Classic: solid color. Glass: translucent bar. Floating: a rounded bar away from the window edges.
download_risky: “%1$s” wants to download “%2$s” without you asking. This type of file can run code on your computer.
update_button_title: Qafila %1$s is ready: click to restart and install it
update_button_title_manual: Qafila %1$s is available: click to download it
update_auto_sub: Checks at launch and every 6 hours, downloads in the background
update_footer: To find out whether a new version exists, Qafila only contacts GitHub and sends no personal data. A downloaded version is also installed when you quit Qafila.
bookmarks_bar_sub: Your bookmarks, discreetly under the address bar
bookmarks_bar_empty: Add your favourite sites with ☆ or %1$s
perm_detail: You can change your mind in Settings › Privacy › Site permissions.
perm_detail_private: Private browsing: the answer only lasts until the private tabs are closed.
perm_none: No site has asked for permission yet.
perm_footer: Camera, microphone, location, notifications… Qafila always asks before allowing a site.
perm_screen_prompt: %1$s wants to share your screen. What would you like to share?
ext_add_footer: Opens the Chrome Web Store: the “Add to Chrome” button installs the extension in Qafila, after you confirm.
ext_private_footer: Extensions don't run in private tabs. They update automatically.
ext_install_can: This extension will be able to:
ext_install_nothing: This extension doesn't ask for any special permission.
ext_perm_all_sites: Read and change your data on all sites
ext_perm_tabs: See your tabs and their addresses
ext_perm_nativeMessaging: Communicate with apps on your computer
bar_layout_footer: Two parts: the address in one capsule, the buttons (tabs, +, menu…) in another, side by side (floating bar). Below: bookmarks and shortcuts.
vault_remember_sub: Open the vault without retyping the master password (protected by the system)
vault_intro_title: Your passwords, encrypted on this PC
vault_intro: Qafila keeps your passwords in an encrypted vault protected by a master password. Nobody else, not even Qafila, can read it.
vault_master_footer: ⚠️ Write it down: if it is forgotten, nobody can recover the passwords in the vault.
vault_empty: No passwords yet. Import them from Chrome, Edge or Firefox in “Import and export”, or add one.
vault_copy_footer: A copied password is cleared from the clipboard after 60 seconds.
vault_autolock_footer: The vault locks itself after 5 minutes of inactivity.
vault_create_to_import: Create the vault to import passwords
vault_err_weak: The master password must be at least 12 characters.
vault_err_keychain: This computer cannot protect the key: type the password each time.
vault_err_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
transfer_no_browser: No other browser found on this PC
transfer_from_browser_footer: One click: bookmarks are added to Qafila's, without duplicates.
transfer_file_footer: Qafila recognises the file type by itself. Passwords go into the encrypted vault; existing ones are not duplicated.
transfer_file_footer_novault: Qafila recognises the file type by itself. For passwords, create the vault first.
transfer_guide_title: Getting your passwords out of the other browser
transfer_guide_chrome: ⋮ › Passwords and autofill › Password Manager › Settings › Export passwords
transfer_export_bookmarks_sub: %1$d bookmarks · HTML file readable by Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari
transfer_export_backup_sub: Settings and bookmarks, to get Qafila back as it is on another PC
transfer_export_passwords_sub: Unencrypted CSV file · asks for the master password
transfer_export_footer: Files go straight to your Downloads folder. Nothing is sent over the internet.
transfer_already: %1$d were already in Qafila and were not duplicated.
transfer_format_soon: This password format is coming soon. Export from Chrome, Edge or Firefox instead.
transfer_unknown_file: This file is not a bookmarks file, a password export or a Qafila backup.
transfer_unknown_file_sub: Bookmarks: .html file exported by a browser. Passwords: .csv file exported by Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
transfer_backup_confirm_sub: Your settings will be replaced by the backup's. Bookmarks are added to Qafila's, without duplicates.
transfer_write_failed: The file could not be saved.
transfer_no_bookmarks: You have no bookmarks to export yet.
transfer_vault_needed_sub: Settings › Passwords: choose a master password, then import this file again.
transfer_vault_locked_sub: Open it in Settings › Passwords, then import this file again.
transfer_pw_skipped: %1$d rows skipped (invalid address or field too long).
transfer_pw_delete_hint: This CSV file contains your passwords in plain text: better delete it now.
transfer_pw_export_warn: This file will not be encrypted
transfer_pw_export_warn_sub: Anyone who opens it will see your passwords. Keep it safe and delete it after use.
sizes_footer: Interface: makes all of Qafila's interface bigger or smaller (bar, menus, settings). Page text size is set in Reading.
start_privacy: No data collected · Encrypted passwords · Everything stays on this device
privacy_card_sub: No account, no ads, no telemetry. Your passwords are encrypted (AES-256) in a vault only you can open with your master password; neither Qafila nor anyone else can read them. History, bookmarks and passwords stay on this computer; private tabs leave no trace.
bm_delete_folder_sub: Deleting a folder keeps its content: bookmarks and subfolders move up one level.
bm_footer: Drag a bookmark onto a folder to file it, or before another bookmark to reorder.
bm_folder_empty: This folder is empty: drag bookmarks here.
